name: Aadesh Shah
title: Aadesh Shah | Software, Systems & Applied AI
description: Computer Engineering at NC State. Agentic AI and LLM applications, backend and cloud systems, performance engineering, and efficient machine learning.
intro: I’m a Computer Engineering student at NC State, completing my bachelor’s in December 2027. I’m interested in software engineering, backend applications, applied AI, and systems performance. Currently, I’m an SDE intern at AWS, building an agentic application for data center planning.
about: I enjoy understanding how systems work and making them more useful, efficient, and reliable. I’m especially interested in agentic AI and LLM applications, backend systems, cloud infrastructure, and systems design. My work also spans compiler tooling, computer architecture, performance optimization, and efficient machine learning.
I’m open to a broad range of software engineering roles, especially work that involves solving practical problems and learning unfamiliar technologies.

experience.summary: Built an end-to-end agentic app that turns plain-language requests into coordinated, validated edits across 80+ interconnected input files for data center planning simulations.
experience.detailSummary: Small configuration changes that took hours now take a few minutes; larger changes that could take days can be prepared in approximately 30 minutes.
contributions: Built a Strands agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime that coordinates configuration edits, with Pydantic validation and user approval before generating simulation inputs in S3. The application prepares inputs in the background, helping the team compare fulfillment plans and evaluate how to meet customer demand.

Built an ECS task on AWS Fargate that generates dynamic schemas, field specifications, and a dependency graph for 80+ configuration files. These guide the agent through requested changes that affect multiple related inputs, helping keep edits consistent.
Built the web interface and CI/CD pipeline, along with a custom CLI to invoke the agent.
Persisted plans in S3 using generated plan IDs and IAM-verified user IDs, preserving configuration changes and user intent across sessions.
Converted and cached frequently used JSON/JSONL inputs as Parquet, enabling faster reads through DuckDB without repeatedly reading or streaming the original files.

Fixed an S3 lifecycle issue retaining incomplete multipart uploads and automated cleanup to prevent approximately $800/month in recurring storage costs after uncovering approximately $12K in accumulated charges.

experience.summary: Developed backend services and monitoring for an internal vulnerability-scanning system covering container images used in Tanium’s cloud environment.
contributions: Built a Go pre-scan filtering service for the internal vulnerability scanner API, identifying approximately 40% of incoming Docker images as unprocessable before downstream scanning and reducing Lambda failure rates from 30% to 1%.
Built a Python service aggregating vulnerability scan results across 40 production targets, integrating CloudWatch and Slack APIs to surface critical failures.
Implemented automated failure detection and Grafana alerting across 10 production security services, resolving IAM barriers to cross-region monitoring.

experience.summary: Developed C/C++ software for radio control systems across 5+ product lines, working with customers and engineers through iterative prototyping and validation.
experience.highlight: Radio control systems across 5+ product lines
contributions: Built multithreaded FreeRTOS applications on NXP i.MX RT1050 microcontrollers, tuning task scheduling and hardware responsiveness under real-time constraints.
Developed validation frameworks for RF-based CAN communications to check fault handling and protocol behavior across hardware configurations.
Evaluated Qt, Crank Storyboard, and Segger GUI frameworks through documentation review, performance benchmarking, and vendor collaboration to inform platform selection across 5+ product lines.
